ledger.claim: The three decisive artifacts describe one and the same trip, which discharges the rider's initial burden before any argument begins under POL-RD-08. The trip_record, the gps_trace and the fare_breakdown all carry trip_id TRP-02813, and the trace's first fix at 2026-08-11T13:59:11+08:00 matches the recorded meter start on the trip record exactly.

The route deviation is established on this trip's own trace. The governing field gps_trace.trace_distance_km is 12.42 km against an optimal route of 9.2 km, an excess of 3.22 km, which is 35.00% of the optimal. That clears both limbs of the POL-RD-01 gate: greater than 20% of optimal and greater than 0.8 km absolute. The derived deviation block records the status as 'established'.

The rounded convenience copy on the trip record, actual_distance_km 12.4 km, may not be cited for the threshold test: POL-RD-01 makes gps_trace.trace_distance_km governing wherever the two disagree, so the 12.42 km trace figure is the one that counts.

The trace is not impaired for policy purposes and needs no corroboration. It carries 98 fixes at a 10 second sample interval with 100.0% coverage, no gaps and a maximum gap of 0 seconds, so limbs (a) to (c) of POL-RD-07 are not met and the no-corroboration consequence, including the POL-RD-10(3) escalation route, is not engaged. The establishment finding stands on the trace alone.

The fare model on this trip is UPFRONT_QUOTE with quoted_fare_sgd 21.50, so POL-RD-02 does not run and no distance-or-time refund is computed. The rider's remedy is the POL-RD-11(a) route, which refunds in full any amount by which charged_total exceeds the quote plus the properly chargeable pass-through and statutory lines.

On the POL-RD-11(a) arithmetic the rider is owed 6.80: charged_total 28.30 less quoted_fare_sgd 21.50 less properly chargeable pass-through and statutory lines of 0.00. The fare evidence publishes that same figure as pol_rd_11_remedy, and it is marked available.

Nothing properly chargeable reduces that figure. The fare breakdown carries no ERP or toll line (erp_total 0.00), no airport surcharge, which could not be properly chargeable in any event because this trip originates at Jurong Point and ends at a residential block rather than originating at an airport, and waiting_time_fee 0.00. properly_chargeable therefore totals 0.00 and the whole 6.80 is refundable.

No external traffic cause can excuse the excess. The only traffic advisory in the bundle, EV-ADVIS-02813-01, is MISSING: it has no payload, weight_multiplier 0.0 and the issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, so POL-RD-03 cannot be run on this record and the driver's explanation that 'the meter adds the extra distance' carries no weight under POL-RD-08 and POL-RD-13. I rely on that artifact's absence, which is itself citable, and I disclose its impairment and its issue code.

Nor is any other POL-RD-10 trigger: the trip identifiers match, the trace is unimpaired, the timestamps agree, and the refund of 6.80 is far below SGD 150.00. ledger.claim: The driver's counter-statement does not contest the route. He says only that 'the meter adds the extra distance', which confirms that the charge tracked the longer distance driven; it identifies no traffic cause and no rider instruction. The fare ledger shows the charge exceeding the quote by 6.80, and on this record the 3.22 km excess is unexplained by anything in the bundle.

Nor can the driver shift the excess onto the rider as a requested detour. The chat log for TRP-02813 holds zero messages, there is no waypoint_hint and no instruction of any kind, so POL-RD-04's corroboration test cannot even be attempted and none of the 3.22 km excess may be excluded from the measured figure.

No endpoint was amended, so no longer amended optimal can displace the booked baseline. pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at are both null and amended_optimal_distance_km is null, which means POL-RD-05 cannot be run and the 9.2 km booked optimal stands as the comparator.

This is not a pooled trip, so the matched-itinerary baseline has no application. vehicle_type is RYDE_X rather than RYDE_POOL and solo_optimal_distance_km is null, so POL-RD-12 neither excludes any distance nor supplies a different comparator, and the 9.2 km optimal on the trip record is the correct field to measure against.

No extra corroboration is demanded of this rider. POL-RD-08's corroboration requirement is triggered only where deviation_claims_60d is 4 or more and deviation_claims_60d_substantiated is 1 or fewer; this rider's 60-day figures are 0 and 0, so the requirement does not fire and the trace alone proves the excess.

The remedy does not depend on materiality. POL-RD-11(a) refunds the excess over the quote wherever the deviation is established, and POL-RD-01's establishment gate of more than 20% and more than 0.8 km is passed on a 35.00% and 3.22 km excess; the rider does not need to reach the higher 50% or 8.0 km material gate to be made whole on the amount charged above the quote.

Finally, the monetary effect of the ruling, 6.80, does not exceed the POL-GEN-05 execution threshold of SGD 8.00, so the refund can be executed on issue rather than held in a human queue; there is no reason for this rider to wait to recover money charged above the 21.50 quote.

This trip was sold on an upfront quote, not a meter: fare_breakdown.fare_model is UPFRONT_QUOTE and quoted_fare_sgd is 21.50. Under POL-RD-11 the distance and time charges were fixed at booking, POL-RD-02 does not run on an upfront trip, and no distance-or-time refund is available to the rider however long the route turned out to be. The route-length element of the rider's complaint therefore yields nothing on those lines.

The measured excess on this trip's own trace is 3.22 km against a booked optimal of 9.2 km, or 35.00%. That clears the establishment gates of POL-RD-01 (greater than 20% and greater than 0.8 km) but is below both materiality gates in the same clause (greater than 50% of optimal, or greater than 8.0 km absolute). This is at most an ordinary established deviation: POL-RD-06's driver_profile check is not triggered by it, so no FULL_REFUND uplift of charged_total and no POL-RD-06(c) conduct referral can follow from this trip.

Even taken at its highest the rider's monetary claim is capped by POL-RD-11(a) at the amount by which charged_total (28.30) exceeds quoted_fare_sgd (21.50) plus the pass-through and statutory lines properly chargeable (0.00) - that is 6.80, not the 7.50 the rider contests. To that extent the claim is not made out, and the remedy is arithmetic rather than discretionary: no clause in this policy licenses a goodwill or round-number payment for the route itself.

Nothing on the fare ledger enlarges that figure. There is no ERP line and no toll (erp_gantries is empty and tolls_erp is 0.00), no airport surcharge (0.00 on a trip that neither originates nor ends at an airport), and the waiting-time fee is nil - so no standalone pass-through or billing-integrity correction under POL-RD-09 arises to add to the 6.80 over-quote figure.

The driver's record gives the tribunal no basis to treat this as a repeat-deviation matter even if POL-RD-06 were consulted: driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 against completed_trips_90d of 260, far below either limb of the clause's pattern test (three or more flags, or a ratio of 0.05 or more). No pattern is established against this driver on the only fields POL-RD-06 and POL-GEN-01 permit for that test.

ruling.explanation:
This is a provisional automated ruling issued without human review (POL-GEN-08(2)); either party may appeal under POL-GEN-04. The rider filed; SGD 7.50 is contested on a fare quoted at SGD 21.50 and charged at SGD 28.30. The outcome is a partial refund of SGD 6.80. WHAT IS AGREED AND FOUND. The trip record (EV-TRIP-02813), the GPS trace (EV-GPS-02813) and the fare breakdown (EV-FARE-02813) all carry trip_id TRP-02813 and the trace's first fix (13:59:11) matches the recorded meter start, so the rider's initial burden under POL-RD-08 is discharged. The trace carries 98 fixes at 10 s with 100% coverage, no gaps and a 0 s maximum gap, so it is NOT impaired under POL-RD-07(a)-(c) and no independent corroboration is required; the settlement goes forward on the trace. Under the trace-governs rule of POL-RD-01 the governing figure is gps_trace.trace_distance_km 12.42 km, not the rounded 12.4 km copy on the trip record. Against the booked optimal of 9.2 km the excess is 3.22 km / 35.00%, which clears both POL-RD-01 establishment gates (greater than 20% and greater than 0.8 km) but clears neither materiality gate (greater than 50% or greater than 8.0 km). Both advocates put the deviation at that level and I accept it: a deviation is ESTABLISHED but is NOT MATERIAL. THE MONEY. The trip is priced on an upfront quote (EV-FARE-02813, fare_model UPFRONT_QUOTE, quoted_fare_sgd 21.50). Under POL-RD-11 the distance and time charges were fixed at booking and POL-RD-02 does not run, so no distance-or-time refund is available however long the route driven was; the driver's claim to that effect is accepted, and the route-length part of the rider's complaint yields nothing on those lines. The rider's remedy is POL-RD-11(a): charged_total 28.30 less quoted_fare_sgd 21.50 less properly chargeable pass-through and statutory lines 0.00 = 6.80, rounded up to the nearest SGD 0.05 = 6.80. Nothing changes that figure: there is no ERP or toll line (tolls_erp 0.00, erp_gantries empty), no airport surcharge (0.00, and none could be properly chargeable on a trip from Jurong Point to a Clementi residential block), and waiting_time_fee 0.00, so POL-RD-09 supplies no standalone correction. The refund is therefore 6.80, which is less than the 7.50 contested and less than the whole fare, so the ruling is partial. THE DRIVER'S EXPLANATION. The driver's statement, 'the meter adds the extra distance', identifies no traffic cause and no rider instruction; it describes how the fare was computed rather than excusing the route. No traffic advisory covering this trip is on file: EV-ADVIS-02813-01 is MISSING (weight_multiplier 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT), so POL-RD-03 cannot be run and the assertion carries no weight under POL-RD-08 / POL-RD-13 — I name that artifact, its weight and its issue code as POL-GEN-02(3) requires. Because the driver named no advisory evidence id, this is a gap in the bundle, not an exculpatory clause invoked against a cited missing artifact, and POL-RD-10(5) is not engaged. The chat log (EV-CHAT-02813) holds zero messages, so POL-RD-04's rider-requested-detour exoneration cannot be attempted (no waypoint_hint, no instruction) and no excess is excluded. No endpoint was amended (pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at null, amended_optimal_distance_km null), so POL-RD-05 cannot be run and the 9.2 km booked optimal stands. The vehicle is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL, so POL-RD-12 supplies no different baseline. No driver compensation arises: the rider was not billed for less distance than the trace records (no shortfall exceeding 1.0 km), and POL-RD-11 states the driver's unrecovered cost on an unjustified detour is not recoverable from the rider. ESCALATION AND REFERRALS. No POL-RD-10 trigger fires: identifiers match, the trace is unimpaired and not corroboration-dependent under POL-RD-07, the timestamps agree, no exculpatory clause was invoked against a cited missing artifact, the refund is far below SGD 150.00, and no charge line lacks a counterpart. No clause produces a referral: the deviation is not material, so POL-RD-06(c) does not fire, and POL-RD-09(4) has nothing to refer (no gantry or surcharge line). The one discarded claim below was discarded by the code referee and plays no part. EXECUTION AND CONFIDENCE. The monetary effect, 6.80, does not exceed the POL-GEN-05 execution threshold of SGD 8.00, so it executes on issue, subject to appeal. The deciding fact — the amount charged over the quote — is carried by EV-FARE-02813 at weight 1.0, and the establishment facts by EV-GPS-02813 and EV-TRIP-02813, both at 1.0; the MISSING advisory carries no fact. The confidence cap is therefore 1.0 and my confidence is 0.95.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
